response.subject: This week at Yale: free sweets, Handsome Dan, a Ghibli screening
response.intro: Here are the events worth your week, with free food up front and a few open-to-all picks mixed in.

picks.line: Free sweets before break, but it's for Silliman folks only.
Hot Murga and a talk on culture, consent, and care. Open to all.
A family-style dinner after the week, free and open to everyone.
A Ghibli film followed by discussion. Good one for a Tuesday night.
The Handsome Dan weighing tradition, a quick outdoor thing before dark.
Short one-on-one wellness check-ins at the YSC Offline Oasis, no sign-up needed.
